name: zreader_get_named_node
description: zReader_GetNamedNode is a thin wrapper that starts recursive named-node lookup at index 1.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the existing zreader_get_named_node VC target.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48cf70 pushes start index 1 and calls zReader_FindChildRecursive, returning that result directly.
The native smoke validates zReader_GetNamedNode direct, nested, missing, null, and non-array lookup behavior through the accepted recursive helper.
